checks.method: Round-trip and tamper every governed KnowledgeChangeSet field, operation order, dependency, temporal value, closure, base head, state digest, and public change-set ID.
checks.observed: The final private change-set shape is closed, immutable, canonical, and content-addressed. It binds full base ledger and state coordinates, exact contract and source/evidence closures, zero-based ordered operations, valid time, supersession references, and local dependencies. Missing, unknown, noncanonical, cyclic, duplicate-ID, and self-superseding values refuse before state changes.

checks.method: Create a fresh history from an empty accepted graph, append its complete bootstrap atomically, admit one change set, discard the derived graph, and reopen using JSONL alone.
checks.observed: One 25-event JSONL is the only retained semantic/protocol authority. It retains exact contract, machine, policy, mapping, source, registration, change-set, and lifecycle bytes. Replay reconstructs graph-state sha256:4d7d44cc96376261aa2988a2ff957d51030fd4fe7f29fd4b99f5364fc49f3e3c and the same canonical receipt without ambient fixture or program files. Proposal, checks, and decision remain separate events bound to one change-set identity; ACCEPT and application are atomic.

checks.method: Exercise malformed source, mapping, bootstrap, identity, program, change set, lifecycle, ledger, and cross-domain history inputs while checking the external file and replayed graph before and after.
checks.observed: Invalid inputs return typed refusals and preserve the prior ledger and accepted projection. Bootstrap anchors use one JSONL transaction, a partially written lifecycle cannot report success, source and evidence roles cannot be swapped, programmer errors are not hidden as domain refusals, and no legacy candidate identity or graph-writer bypass exists.

checks.method: Run .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/contract_compiler/pareto research/ontology_driven_kg_realization/experiments/small_shop/pareto/test_vertical.py, changed-file Ruff check and format check, canonical JSON byte checks, and git diff checking.
checks.observed: All 140 focused M1 through M3 tests passed. Ruff and formatting passed for the changed Python boundary. The three program artifacts equal the declared compact sorted canonical JSON encoding, and git diff checking found no whitespace errors.

checks.method: Submit each milestone and the final exact implementation to independent read-only P0 through P2 review, reproduce reported defects, add failing regressions, repair narrowly, and re-audit.
checks.observed: The audits found and closed identity, prestate, operand, provenance, atomicity, partial-history, cross-domain, ambient-reopen, and authority-bypass defects. Final regression review of the five-file GREEN reports no P0, P1, or P2 finding and independently confirms the 140-test result, atomic bootstrap, JSONL-only reopen, and absence of oracle reads, legacy fallback, graph persistence, or graph-writer paths.

limitations: This is a private research-local API and artifact set, not a public compiler, wire-format stability promise, general LinkML compatibility claim, package, or release.
The shipped Assent runtime still uses CandidateSubgraphArtifact, AcceptedGraphApplication, and GraphBaseArtifact. This experiment does not cut it over or create a second accepted-state authority.
The graph is a structural current-state replay for this initial population, not a public bitemporal query contract.
The measured operations create entities and relations. Update, delete, correction, and supersession behavior beyond closed reference validation remain future work.
The mapping is one fixture-local closed artifact, not a public mapping DSL. GraphRecipe, OTTR, Prolog, richer policy adapters, and general source population remain outside this cut.
Semantic Re-entry, external action effects, observation, and source-to-correction behavior are deliberately excluded.
No interpreter in another language or completed cross-language conformance result exists.

The repository-wide pytest run was not completed for Milestone 3. The focused boundary and independent audit are the selected Pareto completion evidence; package, wheel, and release commands were not run.
Pre-existing modified research files and untracked design and handover files are excluded from this evidence and were not modified by CC-R11.
